dimensions.assessment: Affects the Department of Commerce, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and entities involved in the installation, operation, and maintenance of undersea fiber optic cables.
dimensions.evidence: prohibit the Secretary from prohibiting, or requiring any permit... for, the installation, continued presence, operation, maintenance, repair, or recovery of undersea fiber optic cables

dimensions.assessment: Removes the Department of Commerce's authority to impose separate sanctuary permit requirements or restrictions on covered undersea cable activities that hold other federal or state licenses.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary may not prohibit, or require any permit, including any special use permit, or other authorization for... undersea fiber optic cables in a national marine sanctuary if a license... has been issued

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the source text.
Amends the National Marine Sanctuaries Act by adding a new section restricting permitting authority and modifying special use permit restrictions.
dimensions.evidence: The National Marine Sanctuaries Act (16 U.S.C. 1431 et seq.) is amended by inserting after section 310 the following

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent limitation on the Department of Commerce's permitting authority within national marine sanctuaries.
dimensions.evidence: The National Marine Sanctuaries Act (16 U.S.C. 1431 et seq.) is amended

missing_information: The number of existing or planned undersea cables and sanctuaries affected is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Prohibits the Department of Commerce from requiring permits or authorizations under the National Marine Sanctuaries Act for undersea fiber optic cable activities in national marine sanctuaries if a state or federal agency has already authorized them.

related.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (S. 1383) to establish the Veterans Advisory Committee on Equal Access, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2189) to modernize Federal firearms laws to account for advancements in technology and less-than-lethal weapons, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 261) to amend the National Marine Sanctuaries Act to prohibit requiring an authorization for the installation, continued presence, operation, maintenance, repair, or recovery of undersea fiber optic cables in a national marine sanctuary if such activities have previously been authorized by a Federal or State agency; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 3617) to amend the Department of Energy Organization Act to secure the supply of critical energy resources, including critical minerals and other materials, and for other purposes; and waiving a requirement of clause 6(a) of rule XIII with respect to consideration of certain resolutions reported from the Committee on Rules.
